title: risk: PKCS#1 magic numbers lack named constants
description: pkcs1_v15_pad_sign(), pkcs1_v15_unpad_verify(), pkcs1_v15_unpad_decrypt() in wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c use magic numbers 11, 3, 2, 10, 8 inline (minimum overhead, header length, min padding string, separator position). A reader must reverse-engineer PKCS#1 v1.5 (RFC 8017 sec.9.2) to verify correctness. Add named constants: PKCS1_V15_MIN_OVERHEAD=11, PKCS1_V15_HEADER_LEN=2, PKCS1_V15_MIN_PS_LEN=8. This also makes the connection to wolfP11-snp7 fix more obvious.
